sections.content: Comparisons and evaluations show relative effectiveness. Spanish uses más/menos... que, tan... como, mejor/peor and superlatives to compare methods and judge their value.

items.spanish: La práctica es más eficaz que memorizar listas.
items.english: Practice is more effective than memorising lists.

items.spanish: Este método es tan útil como el anterior.
items.english: This method is as useful as the previous one.

items.spanish: Para mí, practicar con otras personas es la mejor opción.
items.english: For me, practising with other people is the best option.

sections.content: Use más/menos... que and tan... como for comparison, and mejor/peor or superlatives for evaluation.
